Their infantry are slow but durable, relying on self-reparation and long range weapons for support. The Robots were created by the Elves to perform menial tasks, but when they suddenly gained sentience, the Elves responded with fear, and attempted to obliterate them, forcing the newly self-aware Robots to defend themselves. In the aftermath, the Robots sought to find a new purpose for their existence, dividing themselves into Legions pursuing distinct philosophies and goals in order to find a reason for existing. The Elves developed the Robots in order to serve as assistants with simple labour, but over time, these robots began to fill more and more roles in Elven society. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/robot-legions) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Self-Repair: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. ### Special Rules Ambushing Piercing Shot: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule. Casting Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Destructive: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4). Indirect Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Indirect against once (next time the effect would apply). Infiltrate: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Mobile Artillery: When this model uses a Hold action and shoots at enemies over 9" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. As long this model hasn't moved during the round, when enemy units shoot at it from over 9" away, they get -2 to hit rolls. Ravage(X): When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit. Self-Repair Boost Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Self-Repair Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Spawn(X): Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Swift: This model may ignore the Slow rule. Swift Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Swift once (next time the effect would apply). ### Aura Special Rules Ambush Aura: This model and its unit get Ambush. No Retreat Aura: This model and its unit get No Retreat. Piercing Assault Aura: This model and its unit get Piercing Assault. Protection Feat Aura: This model and its unit get Protection Feat. Reanimation Aura: This model and its unit get Reanimation. Relentless Aura: This model and its unit get Relentless. Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth. Unstoppable when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Unstoppable when shooting. Read more ### Spells Triangulation Bots (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Indirect when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Piercing Bots (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(2). Inspiring Bots (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Rapid Advance once (next time the effect would apply). Flame Bots (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Mending Bots (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Self-Repair Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Gauss Bots (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Destructive. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. ### Units ### Heroes Tri-Scorpion Lord [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 205pts Annihilation Gun(18", A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Harvest Blade(A2, AP(2),
